notes.title: Update - Halted Development
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

I'll cut straight to the point, we've unfortunately been having to reconsider our plans due to a lack of resources and have to place Avanzar development on an indefinite pause.

However, we're still excited to be working on an unrelated, smaller game that we're certain we'll be able to complete (and will still contain frogs 🐸)!

We want to keep this game's page up in case we end up coming back to the project, but at the moment we can't promise that it'll happen.

Looking forward to sharing details about our upcoming game!
- Jampacked Games Dev Team
